name: The Tail of Pippa
source:
Pippa is a girl who was born with a tail and because of this she can't enjoy the things other teenage girls do. Most of all Pippa doesn't want to have her tail and would like to have a boyfriend. On the way you can help or hinder her and meet some amazing people as you try to rid her of her problem. Remember, Pippa's love life is in your hands!

[From [url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/index.html?/shibai/pages/pippastail.html]Otaku World[/url]]
